newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end shade up in range-trading.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end shade up in range-trading.

text.p: The Philippine equities market ended a shade up in dull trading on Wednesday for the second straight session, traders said.
"Big cap issues are on the weak side but market sentiment is generally good for the second and thirdliners," said Irving Ackerman, president at I.Ackerman & Co Inc.
The main index inched up by 1.75 points, or 0.06 percent, to 3,049.49 points.
